verses.text: See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!
lines: See how good and how pleasant it is
for brothers to live together in unity!

verses.text: It is like the precious oil on the head, that ran down on the beard, even Aaron’s beard, that came down on the edge of his robes,
lines: It is like the precious oil on the head,
that ran down on the beard,
that came down on the edge of his robes,

verses.text: like the dew of Hermon, that comes down on the hills of Zion; for there Yahweh gives the blessing, even life forever more.
lines: that comes down on the hills of Zion;
for there Yahweh gives the blessing,
